explanation: From main: compareLinks pins the Compare link codec and its in-app restore; compareTabToolbar checks the Compare summary starts folded with its row count, opens on request and reads one row per gene × population; compareTabContrast opens the folded summary before reading its cells. From this branch: statisticsPolicy.test.ts pins the significanceTier boundaries, and searchPage.test.tsx covers nominal-only and mixed gene rows, nominal pathway rows ordered after FDR rows with their Call labels, and the no-p<0.05 fallback.
